name: Export to CI wizard walks Target, Preview, Configure and Install without installing
description: From the seeded Security Reviewer agent, open the CI tab (empty state 'Not deployed to CI yet'), press Add to CI and walk the wizard Target -> Preview -> Configure -> Install, then stop on the Install step. It NEVER clicks Install, so nothing is written to GitHub, no GitHub token is needed, and no model is called. The Preview step needs the bundled runner: scripts/e2e.sh builds agent-runner/dist and exports AGENT_RUNNER_DIST for the API (without it Preview answers runner_bundle_missing). Finally /ci-runs shows its empty state. 'Add repository' only exists once an installation exists, so it is not part of this flow. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB with acme/payments-api as the only repo and no ci_installations rows — guaranteed by the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
